annotations.title: Classify NAICS, SIC, Federal PSC & State NIGP/UNSPSC Codes

description: Map any company profile, product description, or Statement of Work (SOW) into ranked 6-digit NAICS codes (with official SBA Small Business Size Standards in revenue or headcount), 4-digit SIC codes, 4-character Federal PSC codes, and State NIGP/UNSPSC commodity codes. This is a read-only, stateless taxonomy classification call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `description_text` is required, `context_type` tunes code selection for vendor KYB profiles vs. RFP scopes, and `max_secondary_codes` [1-5, default 3] controls how many secondary NAICS/PSC alternatives are returned alongside the primary code). Use this tool whenever you need industry, procurement, or KYB taxonomy codes and SBA small-business size caps; use `search_historical_awards` instead to query past contract awards once you have a NAICS code, or `parse_b2b_contract` to extract contract dates and dollar values.

context_type.description: Input context mode: 'company_or_vendor_profile' (default, optimizes for SAM.gov vendor registration & FinTech KYB SIC/NAICS), 'rfp_or_sow_scope' (optimizes for solicitation set-aside NAICS & Federal PSC), or 'product_or_service_catalog' (emphasizes NIGP/UNSPSC commodity codes).

description_text.description: Unstructured text describing a company's offerings, a B2B product catalog, or a government RFP/SOW technical scope (20 to 50,000 characters).

max_secondary_codes.description: Maximum number of secondary/alternative NAICS, PSC, and NIGP codes to return in addition to the top-ranked primary code (integer 1 to 5; defaults to 3).

name: classify_naics_psc_nigp

primary_naics.description: Top-ranked 6-digit NAICS code, title, confidence score, and official SBA Small Business Size Standard.

secondary_naics_codes.description: Up to max_secondary_codes alternative 6-digit NAICS classifications.

state_unspsc_and_nigp_codes.description: Matched State SLED NIGP and 8-digit UNSPSC commodity codes.

title: Classify NAICS, SIC, Federal PSC & State NIGP/UNSPSC Codes
